svg.title: Reusable workflow
svg.desc: Workflow illustration, not a deployment diagram: understand business, prepare, confirm scope, execute authorized actions, verify results, review. Tools and methods remain user-specific.

text.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
